notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Dagger and Basilisk Collar attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
